name: Camping Dr.Lauth
beschreibung: The **Dr. Lauth** campsite is located in the municipality of **Ehrwald** in **Tyrol**, close to the German border. Its position at the foot of the **Zugspitze** makes it an ideal starting point for mountain activities. The site is open year-round and offers **pitches** for motorhomes and tents. Facilities include modern sanitary blocks, a **waste disposal and supply station**, and a small grocery store. The area is characterized by the **Zugspitzarena** ski resort and numerous **hiking trails**. In summer, the region is famous for its **via ferratas** and mountain biking routes. Guests often use the site as a base for day trips. The atmosphere is practical and tailored to the needs of active holidaymakers.
